target.title: fix(control-ui-assets): keep emoji / surrogate pairs intact during last-line truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`summarizeCommandOutput` in `src/infra/control-ui-assets.ts` truncates the last non-empty stderr line when an automatic Control UI asset build fails. The previous raw `.slice(0, 239)` could leave a dangling UTF-16 surrogate at the boundary, rendering the diagnostic with a replacement character.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the canonical `truncateUtf16Safe` helper while preserving the existing 239-code-unit payload plus one-character ellipsis. A code-point spread or `Array.from` would avoid malformed text but could expand the established 240-code-unit diagnostic cap substantially for non-BMP input.

## User Impact

Automatic Control UI build failures now return a clean, bounded diagnostic when the final stderr line contains emoji or other supplementary characters at the truncation boundary.

## Evidence

- The regression drives `ensureControlUiAssetsBuilt` through a mocked failed build, with an emoji straddling the 239-code-unit boundary, and asserts the exact returned error message.
- Canonical formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview of exact head `ae267db9a0c5cce6099f8584033eebd74fc02469`: clean, correctness confidence 0.91.
- Exact-head hosted CI is the merge gate.

AI-assisted.
